conviction_note: The H1 numbers were pre-released in the 5 Aug RNS, so Monday's news can only come from the guide. Production has already run above the top of the 34-42 kboepd range, and Brent has been near $100 against a guided $70-100/bbl deck, so a guide raise is likely (print_vs_bar about +4). But this stock sold off 6.7% on its last FCF upgrade, it is up 83% in 60 days and trades above the mean sell-side target. The oil move over the weekend will also dominate. I size the reaction at about half the 0.9 finding sum.

findings.finding: Tullow's own H1 production (c.43.7 kboepd) is already above the top of its 34-42 kboepd FY range. The operator's partner Kosmos reported Jubilee exiting Q2 above 85k bopd gross, with J50 expected to lift it above 90k bopd. That puts Tullow's Q3 net run-rate near 50 kboepd (c.39% of 90k Jubilee + c.8 TEN + c.7.5 gas). The Aug guide of 'high end of 34-42' looks mechanically too low, so a production raise above the range at the interims is likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance-bearing Tullow updates move a lot and in both directions. The FCF upgrade in the 2026-08-05 Trading Statement went to -6.66% (the market focused on flat net debt, per Jefferies via Investing.com). The June 2026 AGM update with 'higher end' language went +8.84%. The H1 2025 results with a guide cut went -18.99%. The last results day after a pre-release trading statement (FY, 2026-04-28) went +11.40%, but the refinancing completion landed the same day. H1 2024 results went +0.87%.
findings.why_not_priced: Tullow has repeated 'high end of 34-42' three times (FY results, AGM update, Aug TS) while printing above 42 each time, so any model anchored on company language sits at 42 or below. If the market had priced a range raise, the reaction to the 5 Aug statement would not have been -6.7%. Most of the 60-day rally lines up with Brent (80 to about 107 at peak) and with Kosmos moving in step, not with a Tullow-specific volume rerating. Caveat: Kosmos is a public, well-read source and analysts can do this arithmetic, so most of it is probably known. That is why the size is small.
findings.independence: Tullow's own 5 Aug RNS: H1 43.7 kboepd, J76 'significantly above expectations', J77 and J50 onstream (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/tullow-oil--tlw/trading-statement/9704842). The AGM update has Jan-May at 43.1 kboepd (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/tullow-oil--tlw/agm-trading-update/9610052).

findings.finding: The FY26 FCF guide ($170-250m at $70-100/bbl) rests on Jan-Jul realisations of c.$93/bbl. Brent front-month traded roughly $88-109 from mid-August to 24 Sep. The company states a sensitivity of about +$30m FCF per +$10/bbl above $80, so the interims are likely to firm the guide toward or above the top of the range.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last FCF upgrade (2026-08-05, from $70-175m to $170-250m) was sold: -6.66% on the day. The June AGM update with FCF upside framing went +8.84%.
findings.original_quote: Cash flow would increase by c.$40 million from $70/bbl to $80/bbl and then by a further c.$30 million for every additional $10/bbl increase, non-linear due to hedges in place.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The stock is up about 43% since 14 Aug alongside Brent, and oil is a public series. What stays unpriced is only the step from 'implied' to 'company-stated'. Brent fell about 7% on 25 Sep (106.60 to 98.82, Yahoo BZ=F), which cools the read-through before the window opens. This finding and the first one both land on the same guidance line, so together they count as one guide raise and are sized that way.
findings.independence: Yahoo BZ=F daily closes: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/BZ=F?range=3mo&interval=1d . Brent was 88.52 on 14 Aug, 107.63 on 10 Sep, 106.60 on 24 Sep and 98.82 intraday on 25 Sep.

outside_window.finding: The April 2026 refinancing requires an M&A process to begin before end-2026; if no binding SPA follows within nine months (by 30 Sep 2027), the New Notes' maturity springs forward to 15 May 2028. It could be launched with the interims, but the equity sign is ambiguous: creditors rank first on proceeds, and it could still bring a takeover premium. Timing in the window is unknown, so it is sized 0.

The ICC arbitration with the Ghana Revenue Authority over loan-interest disallowance (2010-2020) had its hearing postponed to Sep 2026; together with the business-interruption case the assessments total c.$387m plus penalties. An award normally follows months after a hearing.
The TEN FPSO acquisition ($125.6m net) completes at end-Q1 2027, which removes the lease cost.

baseline_tension: The findings agree with the positive priced lean (+1.15, a disclosed short that is not building). They cut against the setup, though: the 60-day run-up is +83%, the stock sits above the mean analyst target, and its last guidance upgrade was sold. The expected move is therefore held at 0.5 against a 0.9 finding sum.
language_note: The regulated RNS text (Investegate) carried the refinancing's M&A-process mandate and the $30m-per-$10/bbl FCF sensitivity. The English wire copy I read (Investing.com, RTTNews summaries of the 5 Aug statement) carried only the headline production/FCF/net-debt numbers and Jefferies' debt concern.
The FCA per-holder historic file named the short holders (Helikon 1.76%, Millennium 0.79%) that the aggregate register and English sources do not.

Otherwise nothing the English sources did not already carry. The UK retail boards (ADVFN, lse.co.uk) were unreadable, and the most material operating datum (Jubilee >90k bopd) came from a US SEC filing, not a UK domestic source.
lessons_applied: 'Two findings resting on one line': the FCF-guide finding overlaps the production finding on one guidance raise and rests on a public oil series, so it was cut from +0.4 to +0.3.
'Tail is intact / understatement': the production finding's high bound was left at +3.0 rather than narrowed, because this name's own reaction median is 7.15%.

'A UK trading update may have pre-released the number' and 'settle the session first' confirmed choices already made (no reported_quarter finding; bmo settled from the RNS and events page). No number moved on them.
